Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking (CXMS) study using the BS3 crosslinker to map protein-protein interactions within the TFIIH complex. While not a standard PTM enrichment, it maps distance constraints (complexome). Acquisition is DDA based on the use of dynamic exclusion and Orbitrap MS1/MS2 settings.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by mass spectrometry consisted of purified recombinant protein complexes (TFIIH, XPA, XPG) isolated via affinity chromatography (HisTrap and amylose resin) and further purified by size-exclusion chromatography (Superose 6) before chemical crosslinking.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This is a structural proteomics study using chemical cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) to map interactions within a reconstituted protein-DNA complex. It is not a differential or perturbation study comparing treated vs control groups; rather, it is a characterization of a single assembled complex. Therefore, it is mapped as un-classified.
